headline: Meerut court sentences woman, lover to death for strangling husband, staging snakebite death
caption:
Meerut court death sentence Ravita Amardeep snakebite murder case 🐍
Meerut ki court ne Ravita aur uske premi Amardeep ko pati Amit Kashyap ke qatl mein maut ki saza sunayi.
Kathit taur par 17 April 2025 ko Amit ka gala ghonta gaya, phir bistar par saanp chhodkar use saanp ka kaatna dikhaya gaya. Post-mortem mein gala ghontne ki baat saamne aayi aur saanp ke daant bhi nahi the.
551 din ke trial, 87 sunwai aur 12 gawahon ke baad faisla aaya. Court ne DM ko teeno bachchon ki dekhbhal ka nirdesh bhi diya.
Kya yeh saza sahi hai? Haan ya Na? Comment karo 👇

headline: Activist Umar Khalid Given International Human Rights Defender Award | Outlook India
caption:
Umar Khalid award 2026: Front Line Defenders ne Umar Khalid ko Asia ka winner chuna 🏆
Umar September 2020 se jail mein hain. Delhi Police Special Cell ne unhe 2020 Delhi dange ki kathit saazish case mein giraftar kiya tha. UAPA aur IPC ki kai dhaaraon mein aarop hain, abhi trial ka faisla nahi aaya.
Award Dublin mein 8 Oct ko diya gaya, Umar Tihar Jail se aa nahi paye.
